text: ポケモンは　パワー　だけ　あったって　かて　ない　ことを！

structure.jp: パワー　だけ　あったって
structure.en: even if you have only power

structure.jp: かて　ない　ことを！

patterns.name: 〜ても
patterns.explanation: たって is a casual spoken form of ても and says 'even if'. パワー　だけ　あったって = 'even if you have just power'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing かつ to かてる turns 'win' into 'can win', and ない makes it 'cannot'. かて　ない = 'can't win'.

patterns.name: 〜こと (nominalizer)
patterns.span: かて　ない　ことを
patterns.explanation: こと after a statement wraps it up as 'the fact that...'. The sentence stops at を, leaving a verb like 'know' unsaid. かて　ない　ことを = 'the fact that you can't win'.
